entry.name: rnbo_line~
entry.description: Linear signal-ramp generator. The fade~ object is an alias to line~ , with the keepramp attribute set to 'true'.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: Sets an initial value for the signal output. The default value is 0.

arguments.name: time
arguments.description: Ramp time is the total amount of time (in milliseconds) in which line~ should reach the target value. This value is only used when a single value is input to the leftmost target inlet. Once a ramp has been completed, this value is set to 0 and must be set again. To keep the last received ramp, see theattribute (or use fade~ object alias).
